company.notes: CIK verified in the EDGAR submissions JSON (name COSTCO WHOLESALE CORP /NEW, ticker COST, exchange Nasdaq, state WA; former names PRICE/COSTCO INC and COSTCO COMPANIES INC). The registrant was formed for the Price/Costco merger approved 1993-10-21; its stock began trading 1993-10-22 (e001, e003). The predecessor Costco Wholesale Corporation was quoted on Nasdaq as COST before the merger (e002), and the 2017 proxy says the Company went public in 1985 (e004), so listed_since_year is 1985. Price/Costco was renamed Costco Companies, Inc. in 1997 and reincorporated in Washington on 1999-08-30 by merging into its subsidiary Costco Wholesale Corporation (e005). Proxy 'director since' dates include predecessor service (e007): James and Meisenbach predate the registrant. The board was classified until shareholders approved declassification on 2019-01-24; classes ended at the 2022 annual meeting (e008, e009). Hamilton E. James has been non-executive Chairman since August 2017; there has been no Lead Independent Director since then.

conflicts.description: Sally Jewell's start day. The 2020 Item 5.07 8-K and the 2019 proxy put the 2020 annual meeting, where she was first elected, on January 22, 2020. Her Form 3 gives an event date of 2020-01-23. Kept 2020-01-22.

2021 annual meeting date. The 2021 Item 5.07 8-K body says the meeting was held 'January 21, 2020', but its cover (date of earliest event) and the 2020 proxy both give January 21, 2021. Treated as a typo; it affects no tenure dates.

Predecessor service. The current proxies date Hamilton E. James from August 1988 and John W. Meisenbach from the company's inception. The 2019 proxy says 'Company' includes the pre-1993 predecessor, and the 1997 proxy says both have been registrant directors only since October 1993 (merger). Kept the proxy-stated predecessor dates, as instructed. The registrant-only start would be 1993-10 for both.

How Galanti and Jelinek left. The 2024 proxy says they were not nominated by the Board for re-election, the 2025 proxy calls their departures 'retirements', and the 2025 8-K says Galanti served on the board until the 2025 Annual Meeting. Recorded did_not_stand, effective at the 2025-01-23 meeting.

open_questions: Gina M. Raimondo (elected 2026-01-15) has no committee assignment in any filing through 2026-09-30. The 2025 proxy says the Board would consider one after her election. The next proxy (expected about December 2026) should settle it.

Six current directors (James, Foulkes, Jewell, Stanton, Wilderotter, Vachris) filed no Form 4 in 2026 through 2026-09-30. Costco's annual director RSU grants are dated October 22, so the fiscal 2027 grant had not been reported by 2026-10-04. All six signed the 2026-06-03 S-3ASR as directors, and no Item 5.02 8-K has been filed since the 2025 proxy. Decker, Denman, Raikes and Raimondo did file Forms 3/4 as directors in 2026.
Charles T. Munger's appointment day in January 1997 is not disclosed. EDGAR full-text search does not cover 1997; he is not in the 1996 proxy slate or the fiscal 1997 Q2 10-Q's vote results.

The day Hamilton E. James became Chairman in August 2017 is not disclosed (the 2017 proxy says only that he was elected after Jeff Brotman's death in August 2017). His Lead Independent Director start is year-only (2005).

John W. Meisenbach's start is year precision (1983), inferred from 'since its inception' plus the 10-K's 'began operations in 1983' and his 2019 8-K's 'over thirty-six years'; no filing states the date. His independence before the 2009 proxy is not reviewed.
Authorized board size is not stated. Munger's, Galanti's and Jelinek's seats were left vacant (2023 and 2025 proxies); the board has had ten directors since 2026-01-15.

Independence for current directors is aligned to tenure; the filings give point-in-time determinations only (2009, 2014 and 2017-2025 proxies reviewed). James's independence before 2005 is not reviewed.

Committees are recorded only from the 2025 proxy (current directors) and the 2022 proxy (Munger), plus Foulkes's 2024-01-18 appointment. Earlier assignments (e.g., Denman on Nominating and Governance 2019-2021, Munger on Compensation in 2019) are not recorded.

Other-board lists come from Costco's own bios as of each filing and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Most bios do not say the company is public (flagged public_company_stated_in_source=false).

Richard M. Libenson filed Forms 4 in October 2019 with the director box checked, but he is not in the 2018 or 2019 proxy director lists or the FY2019 10-K signatures. His departure predates 2020 and is out of scope.

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2025 DEF 14A, the 2026-01-15 Item 5.07 results, the 2026-06-03 S-3ASR signature page, and every 8-K (none with Item 5.02 after the proxy), Form 3 and Form 4 filed through 2026-09-30, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed.

Every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2025 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from October 2019 to September 2026 reviewed. Annual-meeting slates compared year over year. Departures dated from Item 5.07 meeting dates (Meisenbach, Galanti, Jelinek) and the 2023 proxy (Munger's death).

Pre-2020 seats only for directors serving in 2020 or later. Reconstructed from appointment 8-Ks (2004-2017), 1994-1997 proxies and 10-Qs, and later proxy bios. Other pre-2020 directors (e.g., Sinegal, Brotman, Evans, Libenson) are not recorded.
